items.question: Which strategy best demonstrates understanding of ratio meaning?
options: Represent the problem, choose a justified method, solve, and check the result.
Choose an operation before reading the problem.
Copy a similar answer without checking.
Guess and stop.

interactive_activities.title: Explore ratio meaning
interactive_activities.instructions: Complete an age-appropriate task focused specifically on ratio meaning. Record the evidence/work and explain what it shows.

interactive_activities.title: Apply the idea
interactive_activities.instructions: Create a new situation where equivalent ratios is useful. Explain your reasoning and compare it with a second example.

interactive_activities.title: Teach it back
interactive_activities.instructions: Teach application to a beginner in 3–5 clear steps, using an example or demonstration.
